audience: anyone who grew up with a console
summary: Fun and very recognizable, and an excellent Blitz, but the build has traps: 'game boy color' costs a life even though its sales are part of #4 Game Boy, and '3ds' is not recognized at all.
reasons: Every top-10 console is a household name; the tension comes from Xbox One, NES, SNES and GameCube sitting just outside, and the casual player finished 10/10 with one life left.

Split entries make some natural guesses wrong: Game Boy Color, New Nintendo 3DS, Game Boy Advance SP and 'Xbox Series X and Series S' are separate unranked rows, and 'mega drive' lands on a 3 million Tectoy row (#43) instead of #19.
Blitz is deep: a casual player names 21 scoring consoles in 90 seconds.
fixes: Map 'Game Boy Color' and 'GBC' to #4 Game Boy (the source row is Game Boy & Game Boy Color) and remove the unranked Game Boy Color entry.
Add '3DS' to #13 Nintendo 3DS and fold the unranked 'New Nintendo 3DS' into it; add 'DSi' to #3 Nintendo DS; fold unranked 'Game Boy Advance SP' into #11 GBA.
Remove the unranked duplicate 'Xbox Series X and Series S' and add 'Xbox Series S' to #17 Xbox Series X/S.
Rename the Brazil-only Tectoy rows #43 'Mega Drive' and #33 'Master System' (e.g. 'Mega Drive (Tectoy)') so 'mega drive' goes to #19 and 'sega master system' / 'master system' go to #28.

Drop junk aliases: 'Touching is good', 'Tag mode', 'Memory Pak', 'Download Play', 'DS Option Pak', 'Yellow Light of Death', 'YLOD', 'ApocalyPS3', 'Ring-con', 'PlayGo', 'Shareplay', 'Pulse 3D', 'SoundScope', 'Dot matrix with stereo sound', 'PartnerNet'; and remove 'Home video game console generations' from the pool.
